class: Committed date formatting is mistaken for an uncommitted answer
symptom: ADP employment Start Date values correctly displayed as MM/DD/YYYY were repeatedly corrected and eventually reported as could not set when the saved fact was a month and year.
site: Church Mutual ADP application 548, Employment History supervised continuation on 26 October 2026
root_cause: The fill path formats dates for the input, but correction and post-fill verification compare the displayed text with the original month-name answer. Month-only history also must not overwrite a matching imported day.
why_tests_missed: Date formatting and segmented current-job tests did not verify the full correction and not_stuck paths against a committed numeric date.
fix: Use a shared date comparison at the precision of the saved fact for repeated-date correction and date-field post-fill verification. Preserve a matching day when history supplies only month/year; explicit different days remain different.
prevention: Test the displayed result through correction and progression checks, including differing valid formats, month-only facts, explicit day conflicts and invalid input.
